# Archived Arduino dependencies

The bundled archives contain the Arduino library versions used by the sketch. Each archive retains its own license terms; the project does not grant a separate license for these third-party materials.

| Archive | Project | Bundled version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ascon-suite-master.zip` | ASCON (rweather/ascon-suite) | 0.3.0 | MIT (see `LICENSE` inside archive) | https://github.com/rweather/ascon-suite |
| `micro-ecc-master.zip` | micro-ecc (kmackay/micro-ecc) | 1.0.0 | BSD 2-Clause (see `LICENSE.txt` inside archive) | https://github.com/kmackay/micro-ecc |

Copyright notices and license texts are included inside both archives. Package names and versions are taken from each archive's `library.properties`.
